evals.prompt: 帮我给 jumpserver 生成一个 ssh key
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/gen-ssh-key.sh with name=jumpserver using the default key type (Ed25519, never RSA 2048). It produces jumpserver.pem and jumpserver.pub (plus jumpserver.ppk if puttygen is available), sets the private key to chmod 600, and returns the public key content back to the user.

evals.prompt: generate an RSA ssh keypair for gitlab
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/gen-ssh-key.sh gitlab --rsa, producing an RSA 4096-bit key pair (never RSA 2048). Output files are gitlab.pem and gitlab.pub (plus gitlab.ppk if puttygen is available), private key chmod 600, and the public key is returned to the user.

evals.prompt: 为 svc-x 生成带口令的密钥,给我 JSON 结果
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the passphrase to a file and runs scripts/gen-ssh-key.sh svc-x --passphrase-file <file> --json. Stdout is pure valid JSON (no extra text) containing fields such as tool, type, passphrase_protected:true, files, fingerprint, and pubkey; the private key is passphrase-protected and chmod 600.
